contractors.valueTitle: Practical support for project and procurement teams

1.title: From drawings to BOQ
1.body: Share drawings or a bill of quantities to request a scope review, BOQ and quotation.

2.title: One source for the supply package
2.body: Coordinate panels, detectors, bases, sounders, call points, modules, batteries and cables in one package request.

3.title: Authorized supply and brand warranty
3.body: Supply of HST, Apollo and other brands, with authorized distributor warranty subject to each brand's terms.

4.title: Delivery coordination and technical support
4.body: We confirm availability against the requested items, coordinate phased deliveries and provide pre-commissioning technical support.
